metadata.update_lifecycle: Multi-Tenant Distributed Client Release & Versioning Strategy

UPDATE_AVAILABLE_OPTIONAL.action: Non-intrusive toast / notification banner in UI; continue normal POS and sync

UPDATE_REQUIRED_MANDATORY.action: API returns HTTP 426 Upgrade Required with update_url; offline mode locks sync until client updated

offline_upgrade_safety_rules.RULE_1_OUTBOX_PRESERVATION: Application upgrade / packaging update must NEVER delete or truncate IndexedDB outbox queue.
offline_upgrade_safety_rules.RULE_2_INCREMENTAL_SCHEMA_MIGRATION: Dexie/IndexedDB version upgrades must preserve existing transaction records.
offline_upgrade_safety_rules.RULE_3_PAYLOAD_BACKWARD_COMPATIBILITY: Backend bulk-transactions endpoint must accept older sync schemas within min_supported_version window.
